mapper.select: SELECT c.chunk_id, c.doc_id, d.doc_title, d.doc_category, d.standard_code, c.chunk_index, c.clause_no, c.chunk_text, c.applicable_places, c.hazard_tags, c.create_time FROM ehs_kb_chunk c JOIN ehs_kb_document d ON c.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE c.doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY c.chunk_index ASC

SELECT c.chunk_id, c.doc_id, d.doc_title, d.doc_category, d.standard_code, c.chunk_index, c.clause_no, c.chunk_text, c.applicable_places, c.hazard_tags, c.create_time FROM ehs_kb_chunk c JOIN ehs_kb_document d ON c.doc_id = d.doc_id
AND (c.chunk_text ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.hazard_tags ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR d.doc_title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND c.applicable_places ILIKE '%' || #{placeType} || '%'
ORDER BY c.chunk_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ehs_kb_document (notice_id, doc_title, doc_category, standard_code, file_path, ocr_engine, chunk_count, parse_status, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{noticeId}, #{docTitle}, COALESCE(#{docCategory}, 'STANDARD'), #{standardCode}, #{filePath}, 'backend_fallback', COALESCE(#{chunkCount}, 1), 'READY', COALESCE(#{createBy}, 'admin'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO ehs_kb_chunk (doc_id, chunk_index, clause_no, chunk_text, applicable_places, hazard_tags, create_time) VALUES (#{docId}, COALESCE(#{chunkIndex}, 1), #{clauseNo}, #{chunkText}, COALESCE(#{applicablePlaces}, 'production,storage,auxiliary'), COALESCE(#{hazardTags}, ''), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
